$comment: What a route's pending half (*.pending.tsx) may import, besides other *.pending modules, *.logic modules and type-only imports. Pending halves ship in the entry chunk, so each entry here must stay small and context-free; __tests__/route-pending-component-closure.test.ts walks every entry's import closure and fails on closureBanned.
$namedImportsComment: Single exports a pending half may import from a module that is otherwise not pending-safe. The router's URL hooks are there at every pending level, and only with `strict: false` (the rule checks the call).
$syncCacheReadersComment: Synchronous reads of data already in the query cache, by export name from any module, so a pending view can show the controls the loaded page will (no fetch, no subscription).
